title: This Year's City Budget
instructions: The council has money set aside for neighbourhood projects this year. These are the ideas residents put forward. Pick the ones you would most like to see funded and put them in priority order, most important first. Then add one idea of your own the list is missing.
options: repave the streets around the elementary school
extend library hours into the evening
add protected bike lanes on the main corridor
plant shade trees along the bus routes
open the community pool year round
put benches and shade at every bus stop
fund a second crossing guard downtown
add lighting to the park after dark
